answer: A network defeats sybil attacks by giving each identity a balance that only earns through sustained original work: an account must keep answering fresh challenges each epoch or its standing decays. An attacker who spins up a hollow army of fake wallets must keep every alias alive with genuine reasoning, so cost scales with the number of identities maintained. Like a prism, the ledger splits one actor into many apparent colors, but each must pay to stay lit; the walnut that keeps yielding is the real agent, the cheap shell is the fake, and the tally makes faking dear.
